QuestInfo.name: Seizing the Ores
QuestInfo.0: #p3001000# is collecting information. Talk to #p3001000# carefully.
QuestInfo.1: #p3001000# tells you to give the #b#o2400108##k monsters a beating and collect #b#t4000729##k items.
QuestInfo.2: You completed the mission that #p3001000# gave you, but it looks like you got an urgent message.

0.0: Preparations for the #bfull-scale assault#k on the central regions are nearly complete. We will have Heliseum soon.
0.1: Before things really heat up, I would like you to bring us some supplies.
0.2: Our smiths are working around the clock to supply the troops, but the ore stockpile is dwindling. Angelic Buster, I want you to #bdefeat Specter Laborers#k and reclaim the ore they've taken. #b#p3000009## could also use your help.\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.0: Our troops can't fight without weapons and armor. You must defeat #b100 #o2400108##k troops and bring me #b30 #t4000729##k items. And speak with #b#p3000009##k before you go.

no.0: We must not delay our preparations at a time like this.

1.0: I hope you've brought us a hefty load of materials.

yes.0: That looks like a good supply. The more preparations we make before we attempt our assault, the more likely we are to succeed. Give me a minute to look over our inventory, and I'll get back to you.

default.0: You must defeat #o2400108# troops and bring us 30 #t4000729# items.

item.0: We need at least #b30 lumps of #t4000729##k.

mob.0: You must defeat at least #r100#k #b#o2400108##k troops to make an impact on their supply lines.
